title: CodeHilite doesn't escape the language name in the output class attribute
spec: This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`. With Pygments disabled, the language name is put into the `` class attribute without HTML-escaping, so a crafted name breaks out of the attribute. ```python from markdown.extensions.codehilite import CodeHilite print(CodeHilite('text', lang='">
acceptance: Ampersands and angle brackets in the language name are escaped too
Ordinary language names and lang_prefix output are unchanged; existing tests pass
